description: This file defines a class 'OutputCapture' used for capturing and asserting stdout/stderr and logs during unit testing, primarily for unittest support.

classes.name: OutputCapture
classes.description: A class for capturing stdout, stderr, and logs during unit tests, with methods to set log levels, capture output, restore output, and assert expected outputs.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the OutputCapture instance, setting up internal variables.

methods.name: set_log_level
methods.description: Sets the logging level for capturing logs.

methods.name: _capture_output_with_name
methods.description: Captures output from sys stream (stdout or stderr) and redirects it to a StringIO object.

methods.name: _restore_output_with_name
methods.description: Restores sys stream (stdout or stderr) from the saved StringIO object.

methods.name: capture_output
methods.description: Begins capturing stdout, stderr, and logs, returning the captured streams.

methods.name: restore_output
methods.description: Stops capturing, restores original sys streams, and returns captured stdout, stderr, and logs.

methods.name: assert_outputs
methods.description: Runs a function while capturing its stdout, stderr, and logs, then asserts they match expected values.
